disclosures.c8_limitation_travels_with_family: STRUCTURAL LIMITATION (declared, C8): the realized proxy is the realized volatility of the event-adjusted VXX close.  An ETP-leg realized vol is NOT S&P 500 realized vol -- it is implied-complex realized vol: a leveraged, fee-bearing VIX-futures-complex instrument whose realized path embeds roll and decay.  The implied-vs-realized state computed from it is an implied-vs-implied-complex proxy, never the classic implied-vs-spot-realized variance risk premium.
